moat_against: No commanding share: Blue Yonder, SAP, Oracle and Körber contest every tier-1 deal; WMS share estimated only ~15-20%
Services is roughly half of revenue and grows ~3%, dragging gross margin to 53-56% vs pure SaaS peers
Growth decelerated hard in the cloud transition: total revenue +3.7% in FY2025 as license/maintenance attrits
SBC is heavy and rising: $111.3M in FY2025, 28.6% of OCF, requiring large buybacks ($435M TTM) to shrink the count
End-demand tied to retail/logistics capex and macro; bookings are lumpy by management's own guidance language
moat_for: Mission-critical WMS/TMS/OMS installed base with high switching costs and reimplementation risk for customers
Versionless Manhattan Active cloud platform, quarterly updates, unified WMS/TMS/store/order suite for cross-sell
Long contracted backlog: RPO $2.47B at Q2 2026 (+23% YoY), contract duration ~5.5-6 years
Premium pricing position and >70% win rate cited by management; cloud revenue +26% YoY in Q2 2026
Asset-light, debt-free, high cash conversion: OE positive 5/5 years, operating margin expanded to 25.9% in FY2025
moat_justification: Tier-1 WMS leader (~15-20% share) on a versionless cloud platform with mission-critical switching costs, 5.5-6yr contracts and RPO of $2.47B, but share is not commanding vs Blue Yonder/SAP/Oracle, roughly half of revenue is low-growth services, and gross margin (53-56%) reflects that mix; ROIC proxy is not meaningful because the net-cash balance sheet makes invested capital near-zero/negative.
name: Manhattan Associates, Inc.
one_liner: High-quality supply-chain software leader, moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $222.17 (weighted IRR 6.1%, IV@15% $57.93, even super-bull IRR only 9.4%); clears 15% only below ~$58.
